entities.title: Gambit
entities.summary: The game; its folder, Worker, database and path are all called chess (/games/retro/chess).

entities.title: Invitation
entities.summary: An offer of an online game, from a player to an email address, with the colour the sender plays; answered once: accepted, declined or cancelled.
aliases: challenge (in the code, the API and the database)

entities.title: Contact
entities.summary: Someone a player has played: made for both when an invitation is accepted, shown with the record against them.
notToBeConfusedWith: A friend in the top bar's Friends, which is the lobby

entities.title: Record
entities.summary: Wins, losses and draws in finished online games against one contact, from the owner's side.

entities.title: Lobby
entities.summary: The Friends screen: the invitation form, invitations both ways, games in play and contacts.

entities.title: Transcript
entities.summary: A game's entries in order, each with its time: start, moves, chat, draw offers and refusals, resignation and the end.

entities.title: Ply
entities.summary: One move by one side. An action's ply is how many moves were made when the player chose it, so a move made on an old position is refused.
notToBeConfusedWith: A move in the transcript's numbering, where a move by each side is one move

entities.title: UCI move
entities.summary: A move written as from-square, to-square and an optional promotion piece: e2e4, e7e8q. How the API, the database and Stockfish hold moves.
notToBeConfusedWith: SAN, how the transcript shows moves

entities.title: SAN
entities.summary: Standard Algebraic Notation, how the transcript writes moves: Nf3, exd5, O-O, bxa8=Q, Qh4#.

entities.title: Result and reason
entities.summary: 1-0, 0-1, 1/2-1/2, or * in play; with why it ended: checkmate, stalemate, material, repetition, fifty, resign or agreement. abandoned is named in the types, but nothing sets it.

entities.title: Draw offer
entities.summary: One side's offer of a draw: the other accepts or declines, a move refuses it, and offering back accepts.

entities.title: Strength
entities.summary: One of the computer's eight levels, from Pawn Pusher to Stockfish: a Stockfish Skill Level and a search depth or time.

entities.title: Room
entities.summary: The GameRoom Durable Object of one online game, which takes its actions one at a time.

entities.title: Live connection
entities.summary: The WebSocket from a game screen to its room, which sends the whole game after every change.

entities.title: Pace
entities.summary: How much faster than it was played a replay plays: 1×, 4× or 16×.

entities.title: Local game
entities.summary: A game against the computer kept on the device (user://), with an id starting local-.

entities.title: Development sign-in
entities.summary: The stand-in sign-in that takes any address, only with DEV_LOGIN=1 on a local host.
